canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an infinite, boundless light that transcends individual existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Amitabha is the infinite light.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality of the Buddha is omnipresent, infinite, and inherently spiritual in nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The Buddha of Bliss is infinite, boundless, limitless, unceasing, and of a spiritual nature.

canonical_statement: Suffering is an inherent condition of the world, caused by selfish desire.

attributions.surface_quote: Suffering is always in evidence... rising from the desire of selfishness.

canonical_statement: Emancipation from suffering is achieved through the cessation of selfish attachment.

attributions.surface_quote: Emancipation from suffering by abandoning all selfish clinging.

canonical_statement: Perfect enlightenment requires the total renunciation of worldly attachments, including familial bonds and personal desires.

attributions.surface_quote: decided, for the sake of attaining perfect enlightenment, to give up everything dear to him

canonical_statement: Nirvana is a state of blissful rest from which an enlightened being may exert influence upon the world.

attributions.surface_quote: Buddha himself had descended... from his blissful rest in Nirvana to instruct

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of the individual soul involves a return to a transcendent trinity of truth and collective consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: my life will return to the precious trinity of the Buddha, the Truth and the Brotherhood.

canonical_statement: The nature of reality is defined by the problem of origination, which can be understood through specific spiritual discipline.

attributions.surface_quote: Who taught us to read The problem of origination.

canonical_statement: Spiritual perfection is a state attainable through the guidance of a brotherhood and the cultivation of compassion.

attributions.surface_quote: May the Brotherhood receive me and raise me up to their height of spiritual perfection.

canonical_statement: The absence of dissent within a collective body functions as a formal mechanism for the validation of truth or consensus.

attributions.surface_quote: The Brotherhood indicates by its silence that it grants to Charaka the ordination.

canonical_statement: Ethical conduct, specifically the renunciation of violence, theft, and deception, is a prerequisite for spiritual advancement.

attributions.surface_quote: an ordained monk must abstain from carnal indulgence, from theft, from killing, and from boasts.

canonical_statement: The state of immortality is achieved through the cultivation of earnestness.

attributions.surface_quote: Earnestness leads to the State Immortal

canonical_statement: Nirvana is characterized by the cessation of strife and the silencing of boisterous activity.

attributions.surface_quote: Only if like a broken gong... hast thou reached Nirvana

canonical_statement: Existence itself is not inherently evil; only specific negative qualities like vanity, anger, and sloth are detrimental.

attributions.surface_quote: Not existence is evil, but vanity, anger, and sloth

canonical_statement: The internal state of the soul can be fundamentally different from the external appearance of the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: if the venerable Subhuti could have looked into the heart of Charaka

canonical_statement: Spiritual vanity acts as a more perilous impediment to liberation than worldly desire.

attributions.surface_quote: spiritual vanity... is more perilous than the lust of the world

canonical_statement: All compounded phenomena are subject to dissolution and decay.

attributions.surface_quote: doom of compounds which in due time must be dissolved again

canonical_statement: The pursuit of supernatural powers is a manifestation of vanity and a distraction from the path.

attributions.surface_quote: to attempt the performance of supernatural deeds was vanity

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an omnipotent, omnipresent, and omniscient consciousness that serves as the creator and ruler of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Brahma was revered as the Supreme Being, the Great, the Omnipotent, the Omnipresent.

canonical_statement: The existence of traditional deities is neither affirmed nor denied within the Buddhist framework.

attributions.surface_quote: The belief in the ancient gods was not disturbed. Their existence was neither denied nor affirmed.

canonical_statement: The concept of an absolute, singular God is distinct from and transcends the category of specific, anthropomorphic deities.

attributions.surface_quote: My question refers to no one of the gods, but to God.

canonical_statement: The universal essence of a category cannot be reduced to the sum or collection of its individual manifestations.

attributions.surface_quote: I do not want particular fruits, I want fruit in general.

canonical_statement: The concept of an anthropomorphic or named Creator deity is a projection of human imagination.

attributions.surface_quote: an All-God conceived as a being that has name and form is the product

canonical_statement: Individual salvation is a self-directed process that cannot be achieved through the intervention of a deity.

attributions.surface_quote: Every one must find the path of salvation himself

canonical_statement: The existence of an objective, eternal standard of truth is a necessary prerequisite for the pursuit of wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: How shall I... succeed if there be no eternal standard of truth?

canonical_statement: The universe is governed by an inherent order and immutable laws.

attributions.surface_quote: The world in which we live is a world of order

canonical_statement: The concept of a personal deity is a psychological tool for the immature rather than an ontological necessity.

attributions.surface_quote: Children need toys and the immature need gods.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality can be defined as the First Cause, the Perceiver, and the Controller of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Brahma the First Cause of the All, the ultimate reason of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: life is restless and in none of the four states of aggregation can that calmness be found

attributions.surface_quote: We gods, O priest, do not know where the four states of aggregation utterly cease.

attributions.surface_quote: the four states of aggregation: the solid state, the watery state, the fiery state, and the state of air

canonical_statement: The four fundamental states of matter are not eternal and possess a point of cessation.

attributions.surface_quote: where do these four states of aggregation... utterly cease?

canonical_statement: Divine beings and celestial rulers possess limited knowledge regarding the ultimate nature of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: I do not know where these four states of aggregation... utterly cease.

canonical_statement: The ultimate creator or supreme being is characterized by omnipresence and manifests through radiance.

attributions.surface_quote: inasmuch as he is omnipresent, you will see signs and notice a radiance.

attributions.surface_quote: The gods... believe that Brahma sees all things... therefore I answered you as I did.

canonical_statement: The ultimate cessation of the four material elements is a truth beyond the knowledge of celestial beings.

attributions.surface_quote: I do not know where the four states of aggregation... utterly cease.

canonical_statement: Enlightened beings possess knowledge of the fundamental cessation of material reality that deities lack.

attributions.surface_quote: Turn back... and having drawn near to the Blessed One... ask him your question.

canonical_statement: The four material elements (earth, water, fire, air) and the constructs of name and form are not ultimate realities and cease to exist in a state of infinite, non-material consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Where do these four states of aggregation cease?

canonical_statement: Ultimate liberation is a state of mind achieved through internal discipline rather than external divine intervention or ritual.

attributions.surface_quote: The gods cannot help; nor even can Brahma himself.

canonical_statement: The material world is inherently characterized by restlessness and instability.

attributions.surface_quote: The world of matter is restless and remains restless.

canonical_statement: Nirvana is an infinite, radiant, and non-dual state of mind where all dualistic distinctions and material categories vanish.

attributions.surface_quote: There disappear all mine and thine, Good, bad, long, short, and coarse, and fine.

canonical_statement: Individual liberation requires autonomous effort rather than reliance on external authority.

attributions.surface_quote: we must by our own effort become lamps unto ourselves

canonical_statement: Nirvana is the ultimate objective of existence, transcending individual concerns of life and death.

attributions.surface_quote: unconcerned about their own fate... only bent on the aim of reaching Nirvana

canonical_statement: The act of confessing a moral transgression reduces the psychological burden of guilt.

attributions.surface_quote: When a fault is confessed it will lie lightly upon him.

canonical_statement: Intentional dishonesty acts as a metaphysical barrier to spiritual progression and sanctification.

attributions.surface_quote: An intentional lie cuts a man off from sanctification.

canonical_statement: The pursuit of truth for the purpose of self-enhancement is rooted in the illusion of selfhood.

attributions.surface_quote: It is not the truth, then, that thou wantest, but thyself... it is self-enhancement.

canonical_statement: Spiritual development is a progressive path rather than an immediate state of perfection.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art walking on the path, and hast not as yet reached the goal.

canonical_statement: Pleasure and pain are the fundamental constituents of the experience of life.

attributions.surface_quote: Pleasures like pains are the stuff that life is made of.

canonical_statement: The concept of God is synonymous with the totality of truth, goodness, and rightness in the world.

attributions.surface_quote: By God he means all that is right and good and true.

canonical_statement: The state of Buddhahood or the Tathagata transcends the status and power of divine beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Gods, if they exist, are not Buddha's equals.

canonical_statement: The absence of internal falsehood is achieved through the transparent disclosure of one's mental state.

attributions.surface_quote: since you have openly laid bare the state of your mind, there is no longer any falsehood

attributions.surface_quote: there is no law that obliges you to remain in the Brotherhood against your will

attributions.surface_quote: people... resembled even at a short distance dim dusky specters, like guilty ghosts

canonical_statement: The individual soul possesses an existence that precedes its current biological birth.

attributions.surface_quote: I believe that I existed before I was born

attributions.surface_quote: rooted in the mysterious ground from which springs all the life

canonical_statement: The state of celibacy is inherently superior to marriage in terms of spiritual holiness.

attributions.surface_quote: Is not celibacy the state of holiness

canonical_statement: Individual identity is a transient manifestation of a continuous chain of karmic life impulses.

attributions.surface_quote: I am a reproduction of the life impulses that preceded me.

canonical_statement: The ultimate goal of existence is to transcend individual form and unite with an eternal, unchanging substratum.

attributions.surface_quote: I yearn for a union with that eternal substratum of all life.

canonical_statement: Phenomenal reality is illusory and transient, functioning as a dream state relative to the abiding reality of Nirvana.

attributions.surface_quote: Our present existence is phenomenal, while Nirvana is the abiding state.

canonical_statement: Nirvana is not merely a post-mortem state but an attainable condition of enlightenment within the present life.

attributions.surface_quote: By attaining enlightenment, we shall enter Nirvana even in this present life.

canonical_statement: The spiritual nature of the individual is permanent, while bodily existence is transient.

attributions.surface_quote: Comprehension of the transiency of all bodily existence and the permanence of our spiritual nature.

canonical_statement: Existence is inherently characterized by suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: The Tathagata teaches that life is suffering.

canonical_statement: Nirvana represents a state of ultimate bliss and religious calmness.

attributions.surface_quote: I feel the superiority of religious calmness, and the blissfulness of Nirvana.

canonical_statement: The concept of God functions as an ideal synthesis for reconciling conflicting existential desires.

attributions.surface_quote: All these conflicting thoughts produce in me the longing for a solution... I call it God.

canonical_statement: The individual self is a construct to be transcended rather than an object of attachment.

attributions.surface_quote: I do not cling to self, but desire to apply myself.

canonical_statement: Death is a transition point that facilitates rebirth into a state determined by the moral quality of one's past actions.

attributions.surface_quote: I shall die innocent to be reborn in a happier state.

canonical_statement: The ultimate purpose of human existence is the attainment of spiritual salvation or emancipation rather than worldly success.

attributions.surface_quote: Man's first duty is to seek salvation.

canonical_statement: Secular power and worldly prosperity are subordinate to the pursuit of spiritual liberation.

attributions.surface_quote: What is the world if we but gain salvation?

canonical_statement: The physical body and material artifacts are subject to decay and impermanence.

attributions.surface_quote: The king's mighty chariots of iron will rust, And also our bodies resolve into dust

canonical_statement: Moral and volitional actions possess an enduring quality that transcends physical dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: But deeds, 'tis sure, For aye endure.

canonical_statement: Nirvana is to be realized and attained within the context of worldly existence rather than through withdrawal.

attributions.surface_quote: This world is the place in which the test of truth must be made

canonical_statement: The stability and prosperity of a civilization are contingent upon the purity and preservation of the Dharma.

attributions.surface_quote: India's golden age lasted as long as the Dharma was kept pure.

canonical_statement: The fundamental truth or dharma, once initiated, possesses an irreversible and absolute ontological status.

attributions.surface_quote: the wheel of truth which no god... should ever be able to turn back.

canonical_statement: The Buddha acts as an active, guiding intelligence in the lives of individuals, influencing human decision-making.

attributions.surface_quote: The Buddha has guided my steps and induced me to make peace.

canonical_statement: Individual actions are subject to the law of karma, which influences one's spiritual merit and moral trajectory.

attributions.surface_quote: if there is any merit in my action I owe thanks for my karma

attributions.surface_quote: do we worship in Buddha a god or a man?

canonical_statement: Truth is an eternal principle, whereas all individual beings and deities are transient.

attributions.surface_quote: Truth is eternal, but all actual beings, not even excluding the gods, are transient.

canonical_statement: Divinity is defined as the objective reality of goodness, truth, and righteousness rather than a personal creator deity.

attributions.surface_quote: God as goodness, as truth, as righteousness, as love.

canonical_statement: The universe is governed by an inherent, immutable law that directs life toward enlightenment through causal consequences.

attributions.surface_quote: God is the good law that shapes existence, leading life onward toward its highest goal.

canonical_statement: Ultimate truth is an objective, eternal reality independent of mental construction.

attributions.surface_quote: The highest truth is not a fabrication of the mind; the highest truth is eternal.

canonical_statement: The essence of an enlightened being is perceived through intellectual and spiritual recognition rather than physical observation.

attributions.surface_quote: The Buddha can be recognised with the mind's eye alone.

canonical_statement: Buddhahood is an attainable state of being rather than an inherent biological or ontological status.

attributions.surface_quote: A man is not a Buddha by birth, but he can become a Buddha.

canonical_statement: The principle of Amitabha functions as the universal law governing the development and structure of both physical reality and cognitive processes.

attributions.surface_quote: Amitabha is the intrinsic law which... producing uniformities and regularities in both the world of realities and the realm of thought.

canonical_statement: Individual manifestations of wisdom are partial incarnations of a singular, transcendent universal light.

attributions.surface_quote: Wheresoever wisdom appears, there is an incarnation, more or less partial, more or less complete, of Amitabha.

canonical_statement: Existence as a state of being is ontologically distinct from the normative laws that govern it.

attributions.surface_quote: Being is one thing and the norm that moulds it another.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is non-material, spiritual, and accessible exclusively through the mind.

attributions.surface_quote: it is not concrete nor material... yet it exists, it is spiritual and can be discovered by the mind

canonical_statement: Goodness possesses an ontological status that transcends the binary of existence and non-existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Goodness is a reality which exists in both existence and non-existence.

canonical_statement: The universe is governed by an omnipresent, invisible, and intrinsic law that shapes all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: remains for all that exists the intrinsic and necessary norm

canonical_statement: Existence is a synthesis of the universal type and the particular manifestation; neither can exist independently.

attributions.surface_quote: The particular is the realisation of the universal; and the universal constitutes the type

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an impersonal law rather than a personal deity or egoic entity.

attributions.surface_quote: the good law that becomes incarnated in Buddhahood is not a somebody

canonical_statement: The individual ego-soul is an illusion; personal salvation is a heresy.

attributions.surface_quote: We are not ego-souls. For that reason the thought of an individual escape... is a heresy

canonical_statement: The nature of reality is fundamentally interconnected, requiring collective rather than individual liberation.

attributions.surface_quote: We all stand together and every man must work for the salvation of mankind

canonical_statement: The material world serves as the necessary medium for the actualization of spiritual truths.

attributions.surface_quote: In the material body the spiritual truths of goodness and love are actualised.

canonical_statement: The universal is realized only through the specific and the particular.

attributions.surface_quote: It is the particular in which the universal must be realised.

canonical_statement: Enlightenment consists of the sanctification of worldly life rather than its negation.

attributions.surface_quote: Buddha's doctrine is not extinction... but their perfection and sanctification.

attributions.surface_quote: liberation of man's heart from the fetters of selfishness and from the seclusion of a separate egoity.

canonical_statement: All phenomena, including sentient beings and inanimate matter, possess an inherent potential for enlightenment and liberation.

attributions.surface_quote: Even the dumb creatures and inanimate nature are yearning for their emancipation

canonical_statement: The expansion of truth acts as a transformative force upon the structure of reality and all existing conditions.

attributions.surface_quote: The more the truth spreads, the more shall all relations and conditions be transfigured

attributions.surface_quote: Hate is not overcome by hate: By love alone 'tis quelled.

canonical_statement: The cessation of hatred is a necessary condition for the resolution of conflict.

attributions.surface_quote: make an end of hatred by ceasing to hate.

attributions.surface_quote: The policy of long suffering... shows goodness of heart but also a rare gift of wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: hatred cannot be appeased by hatred, but is appeased by love,--and by love only.

canonical_statement: The highest form of wisdom is the cultivation of non-hatred toward all beings.

attributions.surface_quote: to hate no one is the highest wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: a king is responsible for the welfare of his people and cannot let crime go unpunished.

canonical_statement: The potential for moral transformation exists within individuals, allowing for the redemption of misguided intentions.

attributions.surface_quote: I cherish the confidence that the seeds of kindness will fall here upon good soil.

attributions.surface_quote: the first sentence of the four great truths declares that life itself is suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: If Amitabha... fashions the world... why should not life be possible without suffering?

attributions.surface_quote: no amount of discretion could give us happiness so long as we live.

attributions.surface_quote: Life consists of separation and combination; it is a constant meeting and parting.

canonical_statement: Individual existence and identity are determined by the accumulation of past actions and self-determined choices.

attributions.surface_quote: All beings exist by their own karma; they are the incarnation of deeds.

canonical_statement: The divine or universal principle acts as an undifferentiated influence that individuals assimilate according to their own nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Amitabha is like the rain that falls upon the earth without discrimination.

canonical_statement: Individual development is a process of self-education through experience, for which the individual bears sole responsibility.

attributions.surface_quote: Each one is responsible for itself and has learned the lesson of life.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an impersonal, inherent order of cause and effect rather than a sentient deity.

attributions.surface_quote: He is the norm of all existence, the good law, the order and intrinsic harmony.

canonical_statement: Individual existence is self-originated through the exercise of will rather than created by an external power.

attributions.surface_quote: We are not creatures of Amitabha, we are creatures of our own making.

canonical_statement: Self-willed actions are constrained and shaped by the pre-existing, eternal laws of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou hast become what thou art of necessity according to the norms that constitute Amitabha.

canonical_statement: The experience of freedom is evidence against the existence of an external creator deity.

attributions.surface_quote: If an Ishvara had created thee, thou wouldst not have the feeling of freedom.

canonical_statement: Moral outcomes are the result of impersonal causality rather than divine retribution or reward.

attributions.surface_quote: There is neither punishment nor reward... There is only cause and effect.

canonical_statement: Individual fate is the direct causal consequence of one's own actions.

attributions.surface_quote: Their fate is the result of their deeds.

canonical_statement: Physical suffering is an inherent and unavoidable condition of embodied existence.

attributions.surface_quote: While the Tathagata lived in the flesh, he was as much subject to pain.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of spiritual illumination is an omnibenevolent, transcendent principle.

attributions.surface_quote: Buddha-Amitabha, the omnibenevolent source of all illumination.

canonical_statement: The pursuit of truth is a universal human endeavor that transcends specific religious doctrines.

attributions.surface_quote: The Shiva worshipers may be mistaken in their religious views, but they seek the truth.

canonical_statement: Religious practices are valid as long as they do not cause harm to others.

attributions.surface_quote: so long as they do no injury to their neighbors, their worship cannot be disturbed.

canonical_statement: Diverse religious traditions may simultaneously provide beneficial service to the populace.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: the Shiva priests may in their own way do good service to the people.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an impersonal, omnibenevolent law or norm rather than a deified ego.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: The good law is supreme... but that norm is not an Ishvara.

canonical_statement: The divine principle is indifferent to personal worship or praise, focusing instead on the welfare of sentient beings.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Amitabha cares not for prayer, is indifferent to worship, and cannot be flattered.

canonical_statement: Individual existence is defined by the degree to which a being participates in the nature of the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: So far as they partake of his nature, they are his children.

canonical_statement: The highest state of existence is union with a personal, self-conscious divine entity.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: The highest bliss will forever remain a union with Brahma.

canonical_statement: The divine possesses faculties of perception, judgment, and reason analogous to, but superior to, human consciousness.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: He is a higher kind of personality, which includes the faculties of perception, judgment and reason.

canonical_statement: The concept of a supreme creator deity is a metaphysical assumption lacking empirical or ontological verification.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Brahma is an idea, a metaphysical assumption, and his mansion is everywhere and nowhere.

canonical_statement: Religious systems based on inherited authority rather than direct realization are epistemologically blind.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: They are like a string of blind men clinging to one another and leading the blind.

canonical_statement: Conceptualizing the absolute as a static state of 'Being' is a misapprehension of reality compared to the realization of 'Enlightenment'.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Brahma is generally interpreted to mean Being in general, but Amitabha is Enlightenment.

canonical_statement: Human perception often mistakes reflections or conceptual shadows for the underlying reality.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Mistaking the reflection for the reality.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an infinite, omnipresent, and eternal principle of truth and moral law.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Amitabha is an infinite principle, an omnipresent law, an eternal norm.

canonical_statement: The ultimate principle manifests through the embodiment of law, the aspiration of evolutionary transformation, and the bliss of virtuous action.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: He is the Dharmakaya, the Nirmanakaya, and the Sambhogakaya.

canonical_statement: Truth is a singular, multifaceted reality that appears contradictory when viewed through limited, sectarian perspectives.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: The parable of the elephant explains the relation of the truth to sundry doctrines.

canonical_statement: Human knowledge of the ultimate principle is necessarily partial and progressive.

attributions.chapter: THE BUDDHIST ABBOT AND THE BRAHMAN.
attributions.surface_quote: We know something but not all about Amitabha.

canonical_statement: Human perception of ultimate reality is inherently fragmented and limited by the observer's perspective.

attributions.surface_quote: every one of them has a parcel of the truth, but wrong in taking his parcel to be the whole truth.

canonical_statement: The totality of existence transcends any single subjective experience or conceptual framework.

attributions.surface_quote: every one is right in his way, but wrong in taking his parcel to be the whole truth.

canonical_statement: Individual perspectives on ultimate truth are inherently limited and incomplete.

attributions.surface_quote: all of them were purblind... in possession of parcels of the truth.

attributions.surface_quote: existence is not desirable for its own sake. That which gives worth to life is the purpose.

attributions.surface_quote: Our aim is not to live, but... to avoid wrong doing and to let right prevail.

canonical_statement: Moral and ethical truths are eternal and consistent across enlightened teachers.

attributions.surface_quote: All Buddhas teach this doctrine true Which will for aye endure.

attributions.surface_quote: Amitabha is infinite, and thus the possibilities of invention are inexhaustible.

attributions.surface_quote: His art was no magic but consisted simply in observation and experiment.

attributions.surface_quote: The Tathagata has preached the religion of enlightenment... it is now our duty to follow up his thought.

attributions.surface_quote: Lord Buddha, the source of all spiritual light.

canonical_statement: The cultivation of loving-kindness is the primary mechanism for the enlightenment of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The enlightenment of our souls is most important.

attributions.surface_quote: He who is possessed of the highest self, he is able to see Buddha.

attributions.surface_quote: Though Buddha has attained Nirvana, yet may you behold him.

canonical_statement: The ultimate truth manifests in a triple aspect consisting of law, transformation, and bliss.

attributions.surface_quote: Acvaghosha's doctrine of the triple aspect of the highest truth.
